# WHY IT EMPTIED (story dist-2-8, 2026-09-07). It previously held four [BROKEN-DEP] rows —

# All four were ACCURATE and none was repairable: they sit on rows whose `path` does not resolve,
# so none of them ever seeds into an operator's project. Test 1b now validates the set the
# installer actually seeds (filtered by path existence, using the installer's own exported
# predicate), so those four fall out legitimately rather than being deleted to make a test pass.
#
# ⚠ DO NOT "FIX" A FINDING BY REPOINTING A MANIFEST `path` AT `.claude/skills/...`. That was done

# so it passes on a developer machine and hollows out in a clean checkout — a false green. The
# trap has caught four attempts; see convoke-note-backlog-completed-archive.md:355.
